agreement.title: User agreement and data use
agreement.lead: In short: your account will be verified and basic information needed to access our service will be collected.
agreement.intro: This service uses the following information to work with your Discord account and server data:
agreement.item_identity: Your Discord user ID, username, and avatar (to identify your account).
agreement.item_guilds: Your server list and which servers you administer — to show where you can take action.
agreement.item_roles: Your membership status and roles (for permission checks).
agreement.item_join: Server join information — some features may require server access.
agreement.item_email: Your email address — used for account verification, important notices, and support.
agreement.item_activity: In-panel activity; e.g. wallet balance, transactions, and purchase history.
agreement.privacy_prefix: This data is used only to provide the service, verify your account, and run the features you request. OAuth scopes requested during Discord sign-in (e.g. identify, email, guilds, guilds.join) are used only for necessary operations. For our full privacy policy, please visit the
